hard_interpretation_rules: Null acceptance probability >0.10 indicates insufficient specificity of the primary gate.
Recovery of <80% of true factors in the n=75, shared-signal=1.0 core scenario indicates inadequate sensitivity.
Gate thresholds may not change after TARGET-OS, biological, or outcome results.
An inadequate gate is reported as a failed method component rather than silently redefined.

operating_characteristics.false_discovery_proportion: Retained factors unmatched to any true shared factor divided by the number retained; zero when none are retained.
operating_characteristics.familywise_true_factor_recovery: Fraction of non-null replicates recovering every true shared factor.
operating_characteristics.null_acceptance_probability: Fraction of n_shared_factors=0 replicates retaining one or more shared factors.
operating_characteristics.true_positive_rate: True shared factors matched by at least one retained factor divided by the number of true shared factors.

prespecified_reporting: Operating characteristics stratified by n and shared-signal strength.
Wilson 95% confidence intervals for null acceptance and recovery rates.
False-negative and false-discovery summaries without threshold retuning.
Primary, low-sensitivity, and high-sensitivity 05a gate profiles reported.
relationship_to_05a: Prospective simulation addendum created after 05a was frozen and before any simulation-model or TARGET-OS benchmark results were fitted or viewed.

true_factor_match_threshold.purpose: Classify whether a retained estimated factor corresponds to a known true shared factor.
